name: assaying FlowCell material systems
from: A wetted material, coating, membrane, flexible polymer, bearing material, electrofluid, electrolyte, ion/mineral storage system, or active-maintenance material is proposed for a FlowCell function.
to: A bounded qualification or rejection records compatibility, cycling, corrosion/fouling, decontamination, leakage consequence, material loss, and energy/mass accounting where relevant.
cost: Laboratory attention, specimen/material consumption, analytical effort, and test energy.
otherwise: A visually successful phenomenon such as one healing event, voltage, or precipitate is promoted into a durability or energy-storage claim.
